environment.description: Node.js 18 Express application deployed in a gVisor (runsc) sandboxed container with a custom OCI runtime seccomp profile that permits only: read, write, close, fstat, lstat, poll, lseek, mmap, mprotect, munmap, brk, ioctl, access, pipe, dup2, getpid, clone, uname, fcntl, getdents64, getcwd, chdir, fchmod, umask, getuid, getgid, geteuid, getegid, openat, newfstatat, set_tid_address, exit_group, epoll_create1, epoll_ctl, epoll_wait, eventfd2, futex, set_robust_list, clock_gettime, clock_getres, prlimit64, getrandom, statx, io_uring_setup, io_uring_enter, rseq, readlinkat, faccessat2. Notably ABSENT from allowlist: symlinkat, symlink, linkat, link, rename, renameat, renameat2, unlinkat (with AT_REMOVEDIR), execve, execveat, connect, bind, socket, ptrace, mount, pivot_root. The profile is enforced at the kernel boundary via gVisor's sentry which intercepts all syscalls before they reach the host kernel. Additionally, the container filesystem is an overlay with nofollow mount option on /var/app/public preventing symlink resolution during path walks originating from that mount point.
